sub: Be honest: which did you believe?
items: Goldfish can remember things for months
Bulls charge because they hate red
Bulls can't tell red apart. They charge the moving cape
Lightning never strikes the same place twice
The Empire State Building gets hit about 20 times a year
You can see the Great Wall from space
From orbit it's almost impossible to spot with the naked eye
Chameleons change colour to blend in
They change colour mostly to show mood and control heat
outro: Which one fooled you? Comment the number
